title: Arizona State Retirement System (Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 38, Chapter 5, Article 2)
verified_how: Fetched the Title 38 index: 'Chapter 5: Social Security and Retirement (Sec. 38-701-38-954)' with 'Article 2: Arizona State Retirement System (Sec. 38-711-38-794)' (and Article 1: Social Security for Public Officers and Employees, ss 38-701-38-706). Same currency statement (57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session).
notes: Public employees only; police and fire are under Article 4 (PSPRS) and elected officials under Article 3. Private pensions (ERISA) and Social Security are federal; Article 1 is the state's s 218 agreement machinery for Social Security coverage of public employees.
